name: Journify for WooCommerce
author: amineck

sections.description:
Journify for WooCommerce integrates Journify analytics with your WooCommerce store to track customer behavior and purchase events.

IMPORTANT: This plugin connects to external third-party services

This plugin loads the Journify JavaScript SDK which may connect to various third-party analytics and advertising services including:

  • Journify servers (t.journify.io, static.journify.io) – Core analytics service
  • Journiyf-javascript-sdk (https://github.com/journifyio/journify-javascript-sdk)
  • Clevertap-javascript-sdk (https://github.com/CleverTap/clevertap-web-sdk/)
  • Facebook Pixel (connect.facebook.net) – Facebook advertising analytics
  • Google Tag Manager (googletagmanager.com) – Google analytics and advertising
  • TikTok Analytics (analytics.tiktok.com) – TikTok advertising analytics
  • Twitter Ads (static.ads-twitter.com) – Twitter advertising analytics
  • LinkedIn Analytics (snap.licdn.com) – LinkedIn advertising analytics
  • Pinterest Analytics (s.pinimg.com) – Pinterest advertising analytics
  • Snapchat Analytics (sc-static.net) – Snapchat advertising analytics
  • Microsoft Bing Ads (bat.bing.com) – Bing advertising analytics
  • Sentry (sentry.io) – Error tracking and monitoring
  • CloudFront CDN (*.cloudfront.net) – Content delivery network to load clevertap.min.js file
  • CleverTap (static.clevertap.com) – Growth Marketing Platform to load clevertap.min.js file

Account Requirements:
* A Journify account and API write key is required
* Additional accounts with the above services may be needed depending on your Journify configuration
* Data is transmitted to these services according to their respective privacy policies

Features:

  • Tracks key e-commerce events:
    • Page views
    • Product views
    • Product list views
    • Add to cart actions
    • Checkout process
    • Purchases
    • Search queries
    • User sign-ups and logins
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce
  • Lightweight implementation with minimal performance impact

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Journify account with API write key

Configuration

  1. Obtain a write key from your Journify dashboard
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Integrations → Journify
  3. Enter your write key in the designated field
  4. Enable/disable specific tracking events as needed
  5. Save changes

Trademark Notice

WooCommerce is a registered trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by WooCommerce or Automattic Inc.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the journify-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Integrations → Journify
  4. Enter your Journify write key and configure tracking options
sections.faq:
How do I get support for this plugin?

For support, please contact support@journify.io or visit https://journify.io.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is regularly tested with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.
